rationale.text: The page has no doctype and holds a u element. The methodology forbids u only when the doctype does not correspond to HTML 5; it does not say how to read a page with no doctype at all. The custom check answers cannot_tell for a u element with no doctype (step 2); only the record supports this branch. The finding is needs_review at both levels: not_enabled at fail_only, cannot_tell at full.

citations.quote: Vérifier l’absence de l’élément `<u>` uniquement si le DOCTYPE du document ne correspond pas à HTML 5 ;
L’élément <u> est interdit uniquement si le DOCTYPE du document ne correspond pas à HTML 5.
